name: primitives-texts-counting-number
blurb: Number increments smoothly from zero to a target.
description: Animates a numeric display by incrementing the value over a duration, often triggered by scroll into view.
use_when: Statistics, metrics, or KPIs in hero sections or feature cards.
avoid_when: Precise or real-time values — animation introduces rounding and lag.
a11y: End value is readable but animation runs automatically with no pause control.
